confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief to confirm whether LH-06 is stopped or operating. The radio and CMMS disagree. Nothing is moved for this place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C512-10 until about 13:30 (range 12:30–14:30), and the radio and CMMS agree. The stope holds 136 t at 13.4 g/t, which is about 58.6 oz and would sit unmined. LH-08 is on an infrastructure heading worth only 0.5 oz per loader hour. It is the cheapest loader to lend and is 0.69 h away. At 29.1 t/h it clears the 136 t in about 4.7 h and finishes by about 15:30 even with lunch. The cost is about 0.5 oz/h × 5.5 h, or 2.8 oz. LH-07 is 0.39 h away but its stope grades 6.7 g/t, so losing it costs more ore. LH-09 is on a 2.0 oz/h preparation heading, which is too expensive. Central's trucks (91 t/h) can take the extra inflow (about 92 t/h). LH-06 is not moved because of CONFIRM-01.
